description: Every file or folder the mashup reads from either game. Paths are relative to that game's install folder. Nothing listed here is ever shipped; it is read from the player's own copy at run time.

rows.purpose: Proves the folder found through Steam is really Persona 4 Golden (64-bit PC release).
rows._notes: App id 1113000 is the Steam store id. Folder and exe name come from community guides, not from an install.

rows.purpose: PreApp Partners DW_PACK archives holding bustup portraits (and message scripts).
rows._notes: Format from tge-was-taken/preappfile and Sewer56/p4gpc.modloader (DW_PACK header + 0x120-byte entries + chunked Huffman). File glob not yet checked on an install.

rows.purpose: XACT wave bank with the cast's voice clips (battle barks, event lines).
rows._notes: A voice-swap mod replaces SND/ROOT.xwb; p4gpc.modloader redirects XACT banks. Whether ROOT holds voices or BGM is unconfirmed.

rows.purpose: XACT wave bank with P4G's music.
rows._notes: Guess. recon lists every *.xwb under SND with entry counts and durations; pick the bank whose entries are minutes long.

rows.purpose: The process the Reloaded-II mod loads into.
rows._notes: Folder name CatherineClassic is used by Shasties/catherine_character_mods. Exe name from a Steam forum post.

rows.purpose: Loose music/sound files; boss track is redirected here.
rows._notes: A published HQ BGM mod installs by extracting into data/sound, which suggests it uses loose files.

rows.purpose: Stage data; which stage file opens tells the mod where Vincent is.
rows._notes: data/puzzle/object holds block models (c001_000.nif ...) per catherine_character_mods.
